_buildPath: Code-led by deliberate choice, not drift. The primary surface is a single word held at a fixed optical centre; its decisive property is that the pivot glyph does not move BETWEEN FRAMES, which a static comp cannot represent. The type is functional (grapheme-indexed pivot in a three-span grid), so generated type would have to be un-invented. The visual world was chosen by the user from two fully-specified directions, so identity is already settled.
